hypothesis: The hierarchical discrete-state plus learned local low-rank transition recipe from Phase 4 transfers beyond waves to a nonlinear reaction-diffusion system when augmented only with generic center monomials up to cubic order.

simulator.equations: Gray-Scott used only to generate data; its coefficients/terms are not provided to the learned model

training_distribution.initialization: smooth periodic Gaussian blobs, radius 1.5-3.0 with low noise

learned_transition.features: full 3x3 neighborhood of both channels (18) plus generic center monomials u^2, uv, v^2, u^3, u^2v, uv^2, v^3 (7), total 25
learned_transition.per_training_sequence_map: ridge least-squares one-step map from 25 local features to next 2-channel state
learned_transition.family_learning: PCA over flattened per-sequence local maps
learned_transition.latent_inference: ridge least squares from the two observed quantized context transitions
learned_transition.rollout: recursive; requantize through both residual-VQ stages after every predicted step

sharp_ood.initialization: sharp blobs radius 0.8-1.8 plus higher noise

frozen_pass_rule: PASS only if every one of the 3 fresh end-to-end replicates has requantized rollout MSE ratio < 1.0 versus raw-state persistence on all four primary tests: ID h8, sharp-initial-condition OOD h3, parameter OOD h3, and combined OOD h3. No retry or replacement of a failed replicate.
claim_limit: A pass would demonstrate transfer of the representation/learning recipe to a second nonlinear synthetic PDE family. It would not establish unrestricted scientific-law discovery because locality, polynomial features through degree 3, local linear readout, and low-rank family structure are supplied priors.
